messages:
anya: FYI canary run for orenda13b (int4) started hitting OOMs during prefetched long-context requests, rolling back.
marc: ugh. saw the alert too. can you paste the log snippet?
anya: log:
```
2026-03-21T16:12:03Z ERROR oom: alloc failed for kv_cache shm=1228800000
2026-03-21T16:12:03Z WARN  attempt evict failed: no free slot
2026-03-21T16:12:03Z INFO  serving: request id=xx gen_tokens=2048
```
priya: looks like long generations + aggressive prefetch window. what's max_new_tokens default on the model route?
anya: defaults were 2048 for the canary (we were testing big context), batch_size=4, prefetch_window=3
jin: 2048 + prefetch_window=3 on int4 is spicy. memory frag shows up when slots keep growing.
leo: quick wins:
- reduce max_new_tokens default to 512 for canary
- set soft_eviction=true (kv_trim on low mem)
- microbatch to 1 for initial rollouts
marc: agree. also try prefetch_window=1 and enable slot_compactor every 10m for this pool.
priya: propose a short playbook patch I can push to canary config:
```
routes:
  - model: orenda13b-int4
    defaults:
      max_new_tokens: 512
      batch_size: 2
      prefetch_window: 1
    runtime_flags:
      kv_trim_threshold: 0.75
      soft_evict: true
      compactor_interval_s: 600
```
jin: also let's add an adaptive slowstart: start 0.5x traffic for 15m, then 1.0x if no OOMs.
anya: good. add a quality check_gate: run 50 evals from our smoke promptset after deploy, rollback if >1% deg.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary update triggered by priya — job #3712 queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marc: for diagnostics, add a mem-probe route that simulates repeated long-gen (deterministic) but capped tokens, to reproduce quickly.
leo: if OOMs persist, fallback path: serve orenda13b-int8 variant for requests >= 1024 tokens (routing rule)
priya: i'll open a short PR with the config + rollout script and notify infra to bump compactor cadence for the pool.
anya: thanks — i'll hold the rollback until we patch and re-run a 30m canary. will paste updated logs.
jin: bonus: capture nvml-smi per-pod before/after to correlate fragmentation. add `--nvml-snapshot` to smoke job.
anya: noted. tagging @team for follow-up in incident board if we see >3 OOMs in 1h :slightly_frowning_face:
marc: once stable, we should add a model onboarding checklist entry: "int4 prefetch conservative defaults: max_new_tokens<=512, prefetch<=1, soft_evict=yes".
anya: agreed. thanks all :thumbsup:
